decisions.reason: As a low-noise upgrade to the firm’s core infrared-heating line, it likely has low carrying cost and preserves option value in a market still rewarding efficient, differentiated solutions.
Its dedicated product page suggests a meaningful commercial commitment, so despite some overlap with other plaque heaters it is still worth keeping while demand uncertainty remains.
This looks like a niche extension of the established range, and with no clear failure signal the firm would likely keep the option open because the incremental support cost should be limited.
With only weak website prominence and close overlap with other gas-fired infrared tube-heater offers, this option appears more likely to have resolved as marginal and to be pruned for focus.
As a standard plaque-heater offer presented on its own page, it is likely a core volume product whose continued presence supports the firm’s narrow but established product line.
Given the crowded set of very similar launches and limited evidence of standout traction, management would likely reallocate resources away from this overlapping tube-heater variant.
